# Senthilsweb

> Personal site of Senthilnathan Karuppaiah — data platforms, GenAI, DuckDB, and open-source engineering. Every blog post is available as raw markdown by appending `.md` to its URL. All posts (including LinkedIn articles) are queryable as parquet at /data/posts.parquet.
